import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { store } from "../../../backend/schema/store";

export const storeCms = customizeTable<typeof store>("store", {
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["storeId", "managerStaffId", "lastUpdate", "address"]
});
